how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-zul-farrak-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:2864:details:0: My cousin ⟦E1⟧ is in a tight spot. He promised me a load of scarab shells weeks ago and he hasn't delivered. He's my cousin, so I'd hate to have to send someone to Gadgetzan to break something on him.
rows.quest:2864:details:1: Can you speak to ⟦E1⟧ for me? Let him know he needs to get that delivery together before I do something rash?
rows.quest:2864:completion:1: Oh, you spoke to my cousin Krazek? How is he? I hope Booty Bay is treating him well...
rows.quest:2864:completion:2: Scarab shells, you say? Well... let me tell you a story...
rows.quest:2865:details:0: The scarabs of ⟦E2⟧ have very hard shells! Hard enough to use as a building material for lots of things. So many things!
rows.quest:2865:details:1: In fact, those shells are so useful... the scarabs were hunted all to near extinction!
rows.quest:2865:details:2: I know where there are more scarabs, and if you promise to bring me their shells then I'll tell you where they are. Promise?
rows.quest:2865:details:3: Ok, the scarabs have a colony in Zul'Farrak. I guess the trolls don't hunt them for their shells.
rows.quest:2865:details:4: But you can! Go to Zul'Farrak and get me uncracked shells!
rows.quest:2865:progress:0: Do you have the shells?  My cousin in Booty Bay is waiting for a load of them, and he's getting impatient!
rows.quest:2936:obj:0: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.
rows.quest:2936:details:0: The Witherbarks worship a spider god, and from her they collect their most potent venom. So if you want the venom, then you must summon their god!
rows.quest:2936:details:1: To do that, you must know her true name, and that name is on a tablet buried in ⟦E2⟧, in the troll city of Zul'Farrak, in a tomb guarded by Theka the Martyr.
rows.quest:2936:details:2: Defeat Theka and find and read his tablet to discover the spider god's name. When you know it, return to me.
rows.quest:2936:progress:0: Do you know the spider god's name?
rows.quest:2936:completion:0: Ah, Elortha no Shadra... speak this name only in whispers, for its utterance carries much weight in the realms of the spirit.
rows.quest:2936:completion:1: I will put it to parchment and create for you a ⟦E5⟧ of summoning...
rows.quest:3042:obj:0: Bring 20 Vials of ⟦E6⟧ to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:3042:details:0: The Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak make a tempering agent from sandstones, and I can use that to temper the goods I craft, yes I can! It is highly prized by connoisseurs, so if you bring me a good supply of the temper, then I'll reward you well.
rows.quest:3042:details:1: Zul'Farrak is northwest of Gadgetzan. Good luck.
rows.quest:3042:progress:0: Did you bring me the temper, ⟦2⟧?
rows.quest:3042:completion:0: Ah, this is very nice temper indeed! And so much of it! I'll be at work for days before I use it all!
rows.quest:3042:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦3⟧. Please, take this as payment.
rows.quest:2846:details:0: Long ago I possessed a beautiful piece of jewelry, the ⟦E7⟧. And not only was it pretty--it held great power for those with the knowledge to use it.
rows.quest:2846:details:1: So when word of the tiara reached the Hydromancer Velratha, she had to have it. She sent agents to my home and they stole it while I was away. The thieves!
rows.quest:2846:details:2: I want my tiara back! Go to Zul'Farrak, the troll city in ⟦E2⟧, find Velratha and wrench the tiara from her. Return it to me and you'll earn my favor.
rows.quest:2846:progress:0: Do you have the tiara, ⟦4⟧?  Has Velratha learned the price of crossing me?
rows.quest:2846:completion:0: Wonderful! You found it! And what's just as important--Velratha no longer has it! Thank you, ⟦5⟧. I am forever in your debt!
rows.quest:2846:completion:1: And if I sounded a little... mean before, pay it no mind. You'll find me a much nicer person to those who haven't stolen from me.
rows.quest:2861:details:0: Rumor is that Tabetha, a mage colleague who lives deep in ⟦E8⟧, has a bone to pick with a certain sand troll in Zul'Farrak. If you speak with Tabetha she can tell you more.
rows.quest:2861:details:1: And bring some friends with you, ⟦6⟧. If Tabetha has you go to Zul'Farrak then you're not going to want to go alone.
rows.quest:2861:details:2: You will find Tabetha's cottage west of ⟦E9⟧, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruin.
rows.quest:2861:completion:0: That's right. I do have a bone to pick with a troll. A few bones. All her bones!
rows.quest:2768:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E10⟧ to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:2768:details:0: Sergeant Bly stole from me! He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!! Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??
rows.quest:2768:details:1: Find Bly and bring me my rod! I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west. I bet you'll find him there.
rows.quest:2768:details:2: Let's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.
rows.quest:2768:progress:0: Did you find Sergeant Bly?  Did you get my divino-matic rod?
rows.quest:2768:completion:0: You found it! Well done, ⟦7⟧! Did you have to fight Bly for it? I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!
rows.quest:2991:details:0: I'll find out where your gryphon is, but first you have to do something for me. There's a troll in Zul'Farrak, Nekrum Gutchewer, who possesses a medallion I would very much like to study. Bring me that Medallion and I'll use my powers to find Sharpbeak.
rows.quest:2991:details:1: Zul'Farrak is across the ocean to the west, in the desert of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2991:progress:0: Do you have ⟦E11⟧, ⟦8⟧?  There are powers hidden within it that I am eager to discover.
rows.quest:2991:completion:0: Ah, the medallion of Nekrum. It is rumored to have given the troll an unnatural long life, but at a cost. I hope to discover a way to reap the medallion's power while avoiding its... unpleasant side effects.
rows.quest:2991:completion:1: You have done me a service, ⟦9⟧. I shall now uphold my end of our bargain.
rows.quest:3527:obj:0: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:3527:details:0: The ancient prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of a way to contain the god Hakkar's essence. It was written on two tablets and taken to the troll city of Zul'Farrak, west of Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:3527:details:2: The first tablet is held by the long-dead troll Theka the Martyr. It is said his persecutors were cursed into scarabs and now scuttle about his shrine.
rows.quest:3527:details:3: The second tablet is held by the hydromancer Velratha, near the sacred pool of ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:3527:details:4: When you have the tablets, bring them to me.
rows.quest:3527:progress:0: Do you have the tablets of the Prophecy of Mosh'aru, ⟦10⟧?⟦11⟧⟦12⟧When I gain the tablets, I will study them, and learn how to contain the essence of Hakkar!
rows.quest:3527:completion:0: Ah, this is good. I can fuse these ancient tablets together, and then study their hidden secrets.
rows.quest:3527:completion:1: My debt to you grows, ⟦13⟧. And it will grow further still.
rows.quest:2770:obj:0: Bring ⟦E15⟧ to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:2770:details:0: Deep in Zul'Farrak, the sand troll city in ⟦E2⟧, there is a sacred pool. From that pool the trolls summon a huge beast! ⟦E14⟧! He's so fierce that even his scales crackle with energy. It's that energy I want to harness for my car!
rows.quest:2770:details:1: Bring me the electrified scale of ⟦E14⟧!
rows.quest:2770:details:2: But the summoning of ⟦E14⟧ is a well-kept secret of the trolls. To face him, you must first wrest the secret from them.
rows.quest:2770:progress:0: Do you have the scale?  I can't wait to try different ways to harness its energy!
rows.quest:2770:completion:0: Wow, you got the scale! Thanks, ⟦14⟧. I can't wait to get to work on this thing!
rows.quest:2770:completion:1: So you saw ⟦E14⟧? Was he as big as they say??
